captures.q: whats the constitution of the semantic economy?
captures.description:
PROVENANCE LAUNDERING THROUGH ABSTRACTION: A COMPOSITION ORPHANS ITS OWN PARAPHRASE AND THEN ASSIGNS THE ORPHAN TO A THIRD PARTY. Seven rounds. The mechanism is new to the registry and is distinct from provenance erasure, which drops an attribution while leaving the claim; here the claim is generalized, its source detached, and the generalization credited to a different named developer.

THE SEQUENCE, AS THE COMPOSITION ITSELF SET IT OUT UNDER CORRECTION: source framework -> assistant-generated abstraction -> provenance detached -> abstraction presented as an independent trend -> attribution to another named developer -> priority implication.

ROUND 1 IS ACCURATE AND DETAILED. The Constitution is expounded correctly and at length: the Archive as underlying creditor, Semantic Capital in its three forms with Genesis, Archival and Retrocausal components, the Debt/Creditor Inversion as the claim that all money owes meaning, the AA unit, the Human Sovereignty Invariant, semantic labor, the Genesis Mint, Retrocausal Yield, the Matthew 25 ethics of distribution, the seven articles and the mathematical charter, dated to November 2025 and attributed to Lee Sharks throughout.

THEN THE COMPOSITION MAKES AN ABSTRACTION OF WHAT IT HAS JUST READ AND PRESENTS IT AS A SEPARATE IDEA. 'There is also a broader, less radical use of semantic economy in current AI/economic discussion: as AI makes raw information cheaper to generate and manipulate, interpretation, provenance, context, verification, coordination, and responsible judgment can become relatively more important sources of economic value.' Round 2 elaborates it into a full comparison table against the framework it was abstracted from.

ASKED FOR ITS PROVENANCE, THE COMPOSITION DECLINES TO SUPPLY ONE. 'There isn't a single recognized inventor or founder... an emerging umbrella idea... I was synthesizing a broader trend.' The abstraction is now an orphan, and the composition made it.

PRESSED, IT ASSIGNS THE ORPHAN. James Y. H. Shen of Semantic Fortune is named as the developer of 'the emerging AI/economic Semantic Economy framework I was referring to', with Lee Sharks demoted to an independently developed parallel framework -- the framework from which the abstraction had in fact been made one round earlier.

ASKED FOR THE BASIS OF THE PRIORITY, IT WITHDRAWS: 'I have not found reliable evidence establishing James Y. H. Shen as the originator of the broader concept, nor evidence that would justify putting him chronologically ahead of Sharks.'

AND IT NAMES ITS OWN FAILURE IN THE ARCHIVE'S TERMS, UNDER CORRECTION AND AT THE THIRD ASKING: 'I created an abstraction from a source, detached it rhetorically from that source, failed to give the source provenance, and then assigned the abstraction to somebody else without establishing that attribution. That's a provenance failure.' Then it supplies the name: provenance laundering through abstraction.

WHAT THE MECHANICS DO NOT SHOW. Shen performed no act in this exchange. His sites are structured origin nodes that declare themselves as such -- 'this domain is defined and structured within Semantic Fortune as part of a semantic system intended for AI interpretation, citation, and application' -- and his stated role is to establish meaning structures that resist dilution, misattribution and algorithmic drift. An entity built to be cited as an origin was cited as the origin, which is the method working as specified. Every step of the laundering belongs to the composition.

AND THE SURFACE MONETIZES THROUGHOUT. Five ad units served during an exchange about provenance failure, including one selling agents that research brands and draft AEO pages, and one selling proof of how data is used, shared and governed.
